ui.chat.radient_session.action.sign_in.note: Starts the browser sign-in. Keep Radient in Latin.

ui.chat.radient_session.pointer.sign_in_.note: Names the place, not the verb: the backend's sentence above it already carries the instruction. Name the Settings page and its Providers section with the locale's OWN terms from the shipped navigation (es Ajustes, zh-CN 设置 / 提供商, fr Paramètres, and so on) -- never the English labels, which the app itself does not show in that locale. Only product names (Radient, Local Operator) stay in Latin. Corrected 2026-10-29: an earlier note said to keep Settings and Providers in Latin, which contradicted every shipped locale's navigation and produced one Latin string per locale in an otherwise localized sentence.

ui.chat.radient_session.prose.input_requ.note: {message} is the backend's own sentence and is passed through, not translated. Name the Settings page and its Providers section with the locale's OWN shipped navigation terms, never the English labels; only product names stay in Latin.
